name: Harhajah
title: Goldsmith and Wall Repairer in Jerusalem
summary: Harhajah was the father of Uzziel, one of the goldsmiths who participated in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership. He is mentioned only in Nehemiah 3:8 in connection with the wall work, but his family's contribution shows the commitment among the craftsmen to rebuild the city after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding of Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Harhajah's son Uzziel, who was a goldsmith, took part in repairing the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Contribution of the Craftsmen
keyEvents.description: The goldsmiths, including Harhajah's son, were among the many professional groups that worked together to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Nehemiah's Organization of the Wall Work
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah organized the people into groups to repair different sections of the wall, and Harhajah's family was assigned their section.

keyEvents.title: Completion of the Wall
keyEvents.description: Despite opposition, the wall was completed in 52 days, a work to which Harhajah's family also contributed.
